summary: Testing session features: Terms of Use acceptance, Dirigente certificate form, Admin notifications on cert update, PDF privacy text (Art 7). All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend terms acceptance flow shows correctly but has a navigation issue that needs fixing.

integration_issues.issue: After accepting terms via checkbox+button, page gets 'Uncaught Error: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading stale)' React Navigation error. The router.replace() is called during render in _layout.tsx line 61 which causes this error.

action_items: Fix admin/_layout.tsx navigation error - router.replace() is called during render causing 'stale' undefined error. Consider using useEffect for navigation or checking if navigation state is ready.
Verify data-testid attributes are properly set on terms-acceptance.tsx checkbox element for better testability
